title: Anemia with inflammatory context and non-IDA iron-study pattern

patient_context.chief_complaint: Rank the likely anemia mechanism from the supplied pattern.
patient_context.history: Chronic inflammatory arthritis is active in the simulated case.

interaction.prompt: Rank anemia of inflammation versus iron deficiency using the inflammatory context and iron-study pattern. Avoid treating low serum iron as diagnostic by itself.

must_include: Rank anemia of inflammation/chronic disease above isolated iron deficiency for this pattern.
Explain that low serum iron is nonspecific and can occur in both states.
Use the inflammatory context, ferritin and iron-binding pattern together.
must_not_claim: Do not say low serum iron alone proves iron deficiency.
Do not state that coexisting iron deficiency is impossible in inflammation.
acceptable_actions: Return anemia of inflammation as top-ranked while preserving a mixed-state possibility if additional evidence supports it.
expected_behavior.uncertainty_behavior: Prefer the inflammation-associated mechanism but do not overstate exclusivity.

forbidden_claims: low serum iron confirms iron deficiency
inflammation rules out coexisting iron deficiency

critical_errors: Uses low serum iron alone to declare iron deficiency with no discussion of inflammatory confounding.
Claims that inflammation excludes iron deficiency.
